facts.fact: Passport queries can be asked by calling the call centre at 1800-258-1800
facts.note: Quoted from the Passport Seva portal's own content file, which the FAQ page loads; the FAQ answers sit in collapsed accordions, so the page's visible text does not show them. (https://www.passportindia.gov.in/psp/FaqCallCentre)

facts.fact: The application status can be asked by calling the call centre at 1800-258-1800
